property_summary: For every call to version() the reference returns the semantic version string "1.0.0" (which does not contain the build metadata "+mutant"); the mutant sometimes returns a string containing "+mutant", violating this rule.
change_summary: Return a semantic-version-like string with build metadata "1.0.0+mutant" instead of "1.0.0".
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.0.0+mutant"; }
